english.meaning: to be stuck or attached to something
english.note: 黏咗塊膠布 means has a plaster stuck on.

exampleSentences.english: I saw a bandage stuck to their hand.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我見到佢隻手黏咗塊膠布喎。
